aliasName.description: the alias name of the model.

componentModels.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) collection of active custom Key Value models that need to be composed.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

description.description: An optional description of the model.

displayName.description: A human-friendly name for the model, which can be changed.

freeformTags.description:
A simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type, or scope. It exists for cross-compatibility only.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

id.description: A unique identifier that is immutable after creation.

inferenceUnits.description: Number of replicas required for this model.
inferenceUnits.x-default-description: When unspecified, the number of replicas for the model will be set to 1

isComposedModel.description: Set to true when the model is created by using multiple key value extraction models.

isQuickMode.description: Set to true when experimenting with a new model type or dataset, so model training is quick, with a predefined low number of passes through the training data.

labels.description: The collection of labels used to train the custom model.

language.description: The document language for model training, abbreviated according to the BCP 47 syntax.
language.x-default-description: when unspecified, the document language will be english

lifecycleDetails.description: A message describing the current state in more detail, that can provide actionable information if training failed.

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the model.

maxTrainingTimeInHours.description: The maximum model training time in hours, expressed as a decimal fraction.

modelType.description: The type of the Document model.

projectId.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the project that contains the model.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
Usage of system tag keys. These predefined keys are scoped to namespaces.
For example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

tenancyId.description: The tenancy id of the model.

timeCreated.description: When the model was created, as an RFC3339 datetime string.

timeUpdated.description: When the model was updated, as an RFC3339 datetime string.

trainedTimeInHours.description: The total hours actually used for model training.

ComponentModel.description: The custom model selected for Composition.

modelId.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of active custom Key Value model that need to be composed.

Dataset.description: The base entity which is the input for creating and training a model.

datasetType.description: The dataset type, based on where it is stored.

DatasetSummary.description: Summary of count of samples used during model training.

testSampleCount.description: Number of samples used for testing the model.

trainingSampleCount.description: Number of samples used for training the model.

validationSampleCount.description: Number of samples used for validating the model.

modelType.description: The type of custom model trained.

ModelSubType.description: Sub type model based on the model type.

modelType.description:
Sub type model based on the model type.
The allowed values are:
- `PRE_TRAINED_KEY_VALUE_EXTRACTION`
- `PRE_TRAINED_DOCUMENT_ELEMENTS_EXTRACTION`

ResourceLock.description:
Resource locks prevent certain APIs from being called for the resource.
A full lock prevents both updating and deleting the resource. A lock delete
prevents deleting the resource.

message.description:
A message added by the lock creator. The message typically gives an
indication of why the resource is locked.

relatedResourceId.description: The resource ID that is locking this resource. Indicates that deleting this resource removes the lock.

timeCreated.description: Indicates when the lock was created, in the format defined by RFC 3339.
